note: Europe on 1 September 1939, immediately before the German invasion of Poland. Austria, the Sudetenland and Memel had been annexed by Germany; Bohemia and Moravia were a German protectorate; Slovakia was independent; Albania was under Italian rule. Poland, the Baltic states and Finland were still independent. Modern administrative regions are approximate territorial proxies.

Austria was annexed by Nazi Germany in the Anschluss of March 1938.
Germany annexed the Sudetenland under the Munich Agreement of 1938; modern regions are used as broad proxies.
Germany annexed the Memel Territory from Lithuania in March 1939.

properties.realm: German Reich (Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia)
properties.info: Germany established the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia in March 1939; modern administrative regions are approximate.

properties.label: Slovakia
properties.info: The Slovak Republic declared independence in March 1939 and was closely aligned with Germany.
Hungary annexed Carpathian Ruthenia and gained southern Slovak territory in 1938-39; modern regions are broad proxies.
Italy invaded and annexed Albania in April 1939; the Albanian crown was held by Victor Emmanuel III.

properties.label: Iraq
properties.info: Iraq was an independent kingdom under King Ghazi in 1939.
Syria and Lebanon remained under the French Mandate in 1939.
The British Mandate for Palestine was in force in 1939.
Transjordan was a self-governing emirate under British mandate in 1939.

properties.label: Saudi Arabia
properties.info: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia had been unified under Abdulaziz Ibn Saud in 1932.

properties.realm: Republic of Turkey (Kars, Ardahan and Artvin)
properties.info: Turkey recovered Kars, Ardahan and Artvin from Soviet control under the 1921 Treaty of Kars.
